1.mascotDialogue: One edge, but two entries in the adjacency matrix. Forget the second, and you have quietly built half a directed graph instead.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2 and line 3 are not optional extras of one another — they are the same conceptual edge, and must be added together, as a single atomic pair, every time.

3.mascotDialogue: No arrowheads this time — only a plain line, because the connection is mutual by its very nature.

4.mascotDialogue: The visual shows a single arrowhead where an undirected graph should never have one at all — this mismatch is the mistake, made impossible to overlook.
